objective: Test whether combining projected-addressed RWKV vector FiLM with a quarter-strength recurrent value residual preserves exact zero-state identity while making row and layer interventions material and bounded.

authorization_basis.diagnosis: Projected addressing and vector FiLM made recurrence active and layer-sensitive, but the correct recurrent row was not preferred to a matched donor.
authorization_basis.response: Retain the addressed FiLM controller and add a small addressed recurrent value residual, using the 0.125 FiLM gain and 0.03125 additive gain that were separately screened in prior candidates.

architecture.addressing: Use the projected key/value slot route to select the corresponding RWKV recurrent state slots; bypass the independent recurrent router.
architecture.fusion_equation: projected_read * (1 + 0.125 * direction) + 0.03125 * rms(projected_read) * direction, where direction = tanh(projected_addressed_recurrent_read / rms(projected_addressed_recurrent_read))
architecture.recurrent_role: projected-addressed bounded elementwise controller plus bounded value residual
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: A zero recurrent state produces zero direction, so fusion is exactly projected-only.

causal_conditions.projected_only: Correct-row projected carrier with recurrent readout bypassed.
causal_conditions.correct_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus correct-row recurrent state addressed by the projected route.
causal_conditions.zero_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus zero recurrent state.
causal_conditions.matched_donor_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus a deterministic different-gold, length-matched donor recurrent state addressed by the correct projected route.
causal_conditions.layer_permuted_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus correct recurrence cyclically moved across all 42 wrapped layers.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize only a separately locked 16-update causal training run with a new source/donor-disjoint open endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the structural failure and move to a query-verified hybrid without training this equation.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, or the unused strength holdout.

claim_policy.pass: May claim only BF16-visible structural sensitivity to recurrent row and layer under fresh initialization.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden without later held-out causal preference and a separately locked native generation result.
